summary_en: Annual dividend FY3/27 raised to ¥105/share (¥52.50 interim, ¥52.50 year-end) from prior guidance of ¥90/share. Increase of ¥15/share reflects upgraded full-year earnings forecast. Consolidated payout ratio target maintained at 30%+.
title_en: Notice of Dividend Forecast Revision (Dividend Increase) for FY3/27
translation_en_brief: Seiko Group announced on 7 August 2026 a revision to its FY3/27 dividend forecast. Annual dividend per share is being raised from the prior guidance of ¥90 (¥45 interim, ¥45 year-end) to ¥105 (¥52.50 interim, ¥52.50 year-end), representing an increase of ¥15 per share. The revision reflects an upgraded full-year consolidated earnings forecast announced in the company's Q1 FY3/27 earnings release dated the same day. The company's fundamental capital allocation policy prioritizes internal capital strengthening and stable profit distribution to shareholders, with a consolidated payout ratio floor of 30% or higher. The increase brings the revised annual dividend slightly below the prior fiscal year's actual distribution of ¥82.50 per share on a stock-split-adjusted basis (the prior period yielded ¥165 before the 2:1 split effected 1 April 2026).
